items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey is active.
items.why: Official active listing after foot/ribs issues; ETR/Levitan had bigger dock but expected.
items.implication: Plays but monitor for limited snaps early; start if no better options.
items.opportunity: Bigger dock implies possible reduced routes/targets vs full health.
items.conflict: Bigger projection dock vs confirmed active.

items.text: Mike Evans officially active after optimistic GTD on ribs; practiced late week and pushed to play.
items.why: Rap confirms active after ETR GTD and prior optimism notes.
items.implication: Startable but bigger dock for ribs; pain tolerance key.
items.opportunity: Possible reduced snaps/routes if limited by pain.

items.text: Add Lamar to Saquon, Chase, DJ Moore and Mariota among players leaving the game early.
items.why: In-game observations of multiple stars exiting.
items.implication: Immediate fantasy zero or reduced for rest of slate; check statuses.

items.text: WR Ja’Marr Chase is out due to a concussion.
items.why: Evaluated mid-game for concussion then ruled out; ETR watching post-game.
items.implication: Sit; protocol likely impacts next week too.
items.opportunity: Targets/routes to Tee Higgins and other CIN WRs.

items.text: Eagles have downgraded RB Saquon Barkley to out (hamstring).
items.why: In-game hamstring; Schefter confirms downgrade to out after Q to return.
items.implication: Sit immediately; major blow to PHI run game and fantasy.

items.text: Puka Nacua expected to play with only a small dock on projections after groin issue; Rams do not intend to limit his workload.
items.why: ETR weekend summary lists expected; Levitan notes small dock per Schefter report of no workload limit.
items.implication: Full or near-full usage expected; strong WR start.
items.opportunity: No pitch count or snap restriction anticipated; high routes/targets.

items.text: Commanders WR Terry McLaurin officially inactive (hamstring) for London game vs Colts.
items.why: Schefter and Rap confirm out after late-week hamstring; ETR not expected.
items.implication: Sit; targets redistribute in WAS offense with Mariota starting.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes for other WAS WRs.

items.text: Sunday injuries watching: Lamar (ankle), Chase (concussion)/Higgins (adductor), Saquon (hamstring), Rice (hamstring)/Thornton (ankle), McConkey (foot aggravation), DJ Moore (shoulder), others including Pat Bryant, Mariota (knee).
items.why: ETR post-Sunday summary of key fantasy injuries from the day.
items.implication: Priority monitoring for Week 5 statuses/practices; potential absences create waiver/handcuff value.
items.opportunity: Beneficiaries rise if any miss time (e.g. backups for out players).

items.text: Bills WR D.J. Moore aggravated his shoulder injury; not considered long-term issue as of now.
items.implication: Monitor for next week practice; short-term concern low.
items.opportunity: If limited next, targets shift in BUF.

items.text: Chiefs WR Rashee Rice downgraded to doubtful (hamstring).
items.opportunity: Targets to Xavier Worthy, others in KC.

items.text: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson believed day-to-day with ankle injury; left stadium in protective boot; was Q to return then Huntley in.
items.why: In-game ankle; Schefter boot report; Rap day-to-day monitor/treat next week.
items.implication: Monitor closely for Week 5; Huntley contingency.
items.opportunity: If out, Ravens pass game and dual-threat production drop.

items.text: Eagles could be without four key players: RT Lane Johnson (personal Q), WR DeVonta Smith (hamstring), TE Dallas Goedert (knee), LB Zack Baun (concussion).
items.why: Schefter Lane Johnson Q personal; prior Smith/Goedert/Baun issues compound OL/skill depletion.
items.implication: Hurts offense efficiency, pass pro, red-zone; fade PHI pass catchers/Hurts somewhat.
items.opportunity: Increased role for remaining WRs/TEs/RBs if playing; reverse if any unexpectedly in.

items.text: Only small dock on Puka Nacua (groin) now as Rams do not intend to limit workload per Schefter; upgrade relative to prior uncertainty.
items.why: Schefter confirmation of no limit changes projection dock size.
items.implication: Higher projected points; start with confidence.

items.text: Zay Flowers expected to play; tinier dock, not expected to have hard pitch count.
items.why: ETR summary; Levitan cites Fowler no hard pitch count.
items.implication: Viable WR start with minimal restriction risk.

items.text: Jeremiyah Love frustrated with managed snaps (ankle maintenance/long year); not injured mid-game but coaches limiting for freshness; limited second-half plays in close game.
items.why: Post-game quotes via beat; Berry sighs at management.
items.implication: Lower floor if continues; not full workhorse yet.
items.opportunity: Snaps shared; goal-line may go elsewhere (Levitan draft pick jab context).
items.conflict: High draft capital vs limited goal-line/usage.

items.text: Panthers WR Jalen Coker is inactive tonight.
items.implication: Targets to Tetairoa McMillan and other CAR WRs.
items.opportunity: Increased snap/route share for remaining receivers.

items.text: Not one but two Bhayshul Tuten touchdowns have been called back due to penalty.
items.why: In-game; multiple goal-line looks despite penalties.
items.implication: Positive signal for role/opportunity even if scores wiped; stash/monitor.

items.text: Projecting Kenyon Sadiq (back) in and Colby Parkinson (knee/shoulder) out; waiting confirmation. No reports but little dock on Sadiq.
items.implication: Sadiq potential TE stream/upside if confirmed; Parkinson sit.
items.opportunity: TE targets/routes if Sadiq active and Parkinson out.
